description: Rochester, NY - Today, Joe Morelle announced that the United Auto Workers (UAW) Region 9 have endorsed his candidacy for the 25th Congressional District. UAW Region 9 covers Western and Central New York, New Jersey and Pennsylvania.

title: UAW Endorses Morelle - Joe Morelle for Congress
